title: library-index
description: Wrapped library-index.py output: one trimmed row per tracked movie (owned or not) with watch + rating state. Producer-only contract (client:false in the registry) - it is ~0.6 MB and must never be shipped to a phone; insight producers derive card-sized contracts from it.

rating.description: Michael's own rating (1-10) or null if unrated. Never coerce null to 0 - unrated is not a bad rating.
